correctness.rationale: For all m≥2 the exact hub-global branch is a restriction of an orthogonal projection (squared norm ≤1). In the hub-singleton branch at most m−1 leaves select their own value, and all possible Jacobian row Gram matrices are nonnegative and entrywise dominated by the (m−1)-identity-row/one-global-row Gram matrix. Perron monotonicity and its two-dimensional spectral reduction give the exact quadratic root. A strictly positive interior witness realizes the Perron singular direction for every m. The m=1 boundary case has constant 1/√2. Modulus contraction proves the complex extension. The delivered checker confirms 3,534 exact rational Gram identities, 280,270 entrywise comparisons, 22 sharp witnesses and 6,000 direct pair tests, which supplement the general proof.
